name: DomainModel
summary: An object model of the domain carrying both behaviour and data, rather than procedures over records.

roles.name: DomainModel
roles.summary: An assembly whose objects hold the rules as well as the data. Declaring it says what the code is NOT: not a set of transaction scripts, not a table module — so a class here that turns out to be a bag of properties acted on from elsewhere is a defect against a stated intent rather than a matter of taste.
